confidence_notes: Local price indexes provide a baseline for July meals, coffee and draft beer. A small sample of local menus informed cocktail and house wine estimates relative to draft beer. Lodging is modeled for a typical July night, with hostel beds and private rooms the least certain. [CityCost](https://citycost.org/tottori/) [Livingcost](https://livingcost.org/cost/japan/tottori) [Shobee drinks menu](https://syo-be.com/menu-drink/) [Morinosuke menu](https://www.morinosuke.com/)
comparable_city_reasoning: Yonago and other small cities in the San’in region provide a lodging baseline. Tottori’s station-area business hotels and summer demand around the sand dunes informed the July estimates.
